---
title: "Students"
description: "Graduate students for whom I am, or was, the major or co-major professor."
aliases:
  - research/students.html
---

```{r}
source("R/site.R")
a = advisees()
ids = unique(a$person_id)
current = ids[vapply(ids, function(i) any(is.na(a$graduation_date[a$person_id == i])), logical(1))]
alumni  = setdiff(ids, current)
# most recently started (current) or finished (alumni) first
latest = function(i, field) max(iso_floor(a[[field]][a$person_id == i]), na.rm = TRUE)
current = current[order(-vapply(current, function(i) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(latest(i, "start_date"))), 0))]
alumni  = alumni[order(-vapply(alumni, function(i) as.numeric(latest(i, "graduation_date")), 0))]
cards = function(ids) paste0('<ul class="people">',
  paste(vapply(ids, function(i) student_card(i, a[a$person_id == i, ]), ""), collapse = ""), '</ul>')
```

## Current

```{r}
#| output: asis
emit(cards(current))
```

## Alumni

```{r}
#| output: asis
emit(cards(alumni))
```
